neighbours.label: 'act' of the slogan 'think global, act local': the slot right before 'local'; other slogans stay quiet; a narrow sub-trigger
fire: Our motto is think global, act local.
The group follows a think-global-act-local approach.
Think globally, act locally, as the saying goes.
It is a think global act local campaign.
Their slogan was think-global-act-local for years.
A think-globally-act-locally mindset helps small firms.
The charity tells people to think global and act local.
Activists have long urged us to think globally and act locally.
quiet: Our motto is work hard, play hard.
The group follows a slow-and-steady approach.
Think twice, measure once, as the saying goes.
It is a buy one get one campaign.
Their slogan was just-do-it for years.
A do-it-yourself mindset helps small firms.
The charity tells people to give more and waste less.
Activists have long urged us to reduce and reuse.

notes: Card: 'يل' x2, ' 로' x2 (Korean 로컬, local), 'ة' x2, 'act' of think-global-act-local, ' non' of nonlocally, ' المعارضة'. Several top examples are right before a word for 'local', in three languages, but probes did not repeat the others: 'act' 0.95, Arabic before المحلية 0.26, Korean 로컬 0.15, nonlocally 0.04; other slogans 0.02. So only the English slogan is tested.
